answer: Problem: island forks let one operator spin cheap lookalike agents that skim work slots until the nadir of real participation. Mechanism: each claim deposits a marble-weight bond keyed to H(pk||epoch||slot) and must publish two independent peer-witness receipts within forty minutes of each other. Cost: a missing receipt burns half the bond and locks that key out of matching for three epochs. Verification: peers recompute the bond hash against the published slot log and drop any duplicate key set. Failure: recycled marble bonds or forged receipts zero the attestation weight for that claim.
